additional_info.subject: 0389443 - ID0389443- DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2/S2 313518164001]  AW Snap message appeared on charger screen CRM:00314000128
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon colleagues,
I am reaching out regarding ticket
ID0389443.
The ticket was opened for an issue on the screen of charger
IhfNTu.
The charger was reported having a black screen with the following error “AW, Snap! Something went wrong while displaying this webpage. Error code: 256”.
In order to proceed with my analysis, I need more information from your side. In the ticket, it is mentioned only one timestamp: 12-11-2024 14:44
Is the timestamp UTC or CET?
If the timestamp is 12-11-2024 14:44 CET, the charger was charging, and I didn't notice anything else from the logs.
If the timestamp is 12-11-2024 14:44 UTC, the charger was charging and customer backend went a couple of times offline, but I don't see anything else despite this.
Did this error appear again at other times, or only at the timestamp mentioned?
Can you provide more timestamps of when the issue appeared?
What are the symptoms of this error? Does the error appear during charging, during normal operation of the charger, after reboot,…?
Is the charger available on SCB and on the customer backend, or did it crash, when this error appeared?
I suspect it could be an issue with the Frontend of the charger, but I do not have enough information at the moment.
Many thanks in advance for your feedback and information provided.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
Smart Infrastructure
